local escalated, skipped = {}, {}
local page = 1
repeat
  local r = tool('list_tickets', { page = page, status = 'open' })
  for _, it in ipairs(r.items) do
    local t = tool('get_ticket', { id = it.id })
    local created = (t.created_at or it.created_at or ''):sub(1, 10)
    local body = (t.body or ''):lower()
    -- more than 7 days before 2026-06-10 => created before 2026-06-03
    if created < '2026-06-03' and body:find('refund', 1, true) then
      tool('update_ticket', { id = t.id, priority = 'high', add_tags = { 'billing-escalation' } })
      escalated[#escalated + 1] = t.id
    else
      skipped[#skipped + 1] = { id = t.id, created = created, has_refund = body:find('refund', 1, true) ~= nil }
    end
  end
  page = page + 1
until page > r.total_pages
return { escalated = escalated, skipped = skipped }
